import java.util.Scanner;

public class CountOnes {
    static long[] ones = new long[20];

    static int countOnes(long n, int i) {
        int totalOnes = 0;
        while (i > 0) {
            long block = ones[i];
            long times = n / block;
            totalOnes += times * i;
            n %= block;
            if (n == 0) break;
            totalOnes += Math.min(i + countOnes(ones[i] - n, i - 1), countOnes(n, i - 1));
            break;
        }
        return totalOnes;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        ones[0] = 0;
        for (int i = 1; i <= 16; ++i) {
            ones[i] = ones[i - 1] * 10 + 1;
        }
        long n = scanner.nextLong();
        System.out.println(countOnes(n, 16));
        scanner.close();
    }
}
